capture.scope: Pretrained embedding, block 0 LayerNorm, all 12 RWKV-7 blocks (time mix and channel mix), final LayerNorm and all 65,536 vocabulary logits for the last token.
capture.dtype: float32 computation from bfloat16 checkpoint tensors (exact upcast)
capture.implementation: Explicit per-token PyTorch recurrence in this script; no checkpoint code is run. The checkpoint's own code needs flash-linear-attention Triton kernels, which do not run on macOS.

reference.path: RWKV_x070 forward_seq, strategy "cpu fp32", RWKV_JIT_ON=0, RWKV_CUDA_ON=0
reference.keyLayout: fla names renamed to BlinkDL names; LoRA matrices transposed; no values changed

notes: States are the full 64x64 matrix of every head after every token, as [token][head][value][key].

mixing, scores and decayOnly are computed in float64 from the recorded tensors; their upper triangles are 0 because no token reads a later one. scores (k_i . r_t) and decayOnly (decay without the delta-rule term) are comparisons, not quantities the model computes.
